The official `04-train.webp` asset visibly shows a dataset/project list. The chapter labels it as data and project management; model training is explained by a separate animated diagram.

Product content covers project/data organization, labeling, classification, detection, segmentation, anomaly detection, model training, validation and deployment. No new accuracy, labor-saving or deployment-speed claims are added. Values appearing inside official screenshots are demonstration data.

The five case films and thumbnails remain the existing user-supplied Pitch v5 assets; see [vision credits](../vision/CREDITS.md). Diagrams and hardware illustrations are original SVG/CSS concepts, not equipment specifications, a live model run or measured customer outcomes. Model feedback does not imply unattended automatic retraining.

The WinEdge product/service/partner narrative is based on the user's stated strategy. Partner categories are an invitation to collaborate, not a list of signed agreements, commercial terms or endorsements.
